page: Vultr voc-c-32c-64gb-1000s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an AMD EPYC processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with multithreading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 32 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity is 64.0 GB, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Storage is bundled with a 1000 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across compute and memory subsystems. The server achieves top-tier status in stress-ng single-core CPU performance and PassMark memory testing. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and cryptographic operations via AES and SHA instruction sets rank in the top 25%. In software compilation and ray tracing benchmarks, the system also places in the top 25%. Large-block memory bandwidth reaches 346.3 GB/sec for read operations, while Redis SET operations sustain 76.91 million operations per second.

For specialized workloads, the server demonstrates top-tier text generation speeds during LLM inference on both small and medium models, processing 360.86 tokens per second on a 135M model and 43.67 tokens per second on a 7B model. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This hardware profile offers high resource density and compute-to-memory efficiency, making it suitable for multi-threaded decompression, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale machine learning inference.
